contamination_assertion.note: MedQA questions are not generated from indexed corpus docs; the PubMedQA test-PMID blocklist (src/eval/contamination.py) does not apply. MedQA textbooks are in the corpus by design (ADR-009), not a leak.

metrics.macro_f1_note: position-bias check, NOT a skill metric for 4-option MCQ; Accuracy is the headline
metrics.verifier_decision_rate_note: fraction of questions where exactly one option verified SUPPORTED (verifier decided) vs. fell back to B2-style generation. A high fallback rate is direct evidence for the binary bottleneck C2 targets, not a defect of this run.
